cells.name: iptables, callers learn that a pod cannot serve: in band with a shared gate

prediction.text: The algebra predicts that the replica leaves the EndpointSlice and the rules of each node. The band is 12 s to 24.105 s after the fault. The flag fails the route of the target and its check, a check of no dependency. Redis stays up. Thus the shared gate leaves the readiness probe as it is, and the kubelet and the propagation remove the target 12 s–24.105 s after the fault, as for B. Each request on the target fails until the latch trips (8 s–18 s), and the lame duck closes its connection. Thus E has the band of B: approximately 350–1913 failed requests.

cells.why: Each of the 3 counted runs agrees with the prediction. The median is 18.616 s. The counted runs measured 16.76 s to 20.847 s.
